Why Penavia

You book once. Local experts run your tour.

Penavia is your booking agency — not the tour bus. You choose your experience and pay in one place; we secure your spot with a vetted local operator in each destination, confirm every detail with them, and stay your single point of contact before, during and after the trip.

Pay Penavia, in USD

No chasing providers and no separate payments in pesos. A 50% deposit to Penavia holds your reservation — we purchase and confirm your tour directly with the operator at their trade rate.

Run by people who do this daily

Your experience is delivered by local specialists — winery hosts, boat crews, certified guides and drivers — selected for safety, punctuality and consistently strong reviews.

Pickup, voucher & support — handled

We coordinate the booking with the provider and send you the meeting point, timing, border-crossing notes and day-of contact, so you just show up and enjoy it.

The Name

PENAVIA

We studied how the agencies that work actually name themselves — Mexico’s big players like Despegar, BestDay and PriceTravel, plus the local Baja operators — and looked for a short name that’s ours and works just as well in English as in Spanish.

Penavia joins “Pena” from Peninsula — we’re from the Baja California Peninsula — with “vía,” the way, the route. It’s where we’re based, and it’s how we connect you with local operators everywhere in Mexico.

Names reviewed in our niche study

  • Penavia — short, pronounceable in English, with its own story. No agency with this exact name appeared in our Mexico/Baja search; trademark and domain checks come before full registration.
  • Rumbo / Ruta Viva / Vámonos — appealing, but already used by other agencies.
  • Alma Viajera / Ando Viajando / Maleta Lista — already in use in the niche.
  • “Travel + city” names (like the many generic Tijuana tour brands) — hard to stand out and hard to trademark.

FAQ

Good to know before you book

Do you pick up in San Diego?

Yes — for Baja tours like Valle de Guadalupe, pickup is available in San Diego and Tijuana. Your quote confirms the exact meeting point and time, plus what to bring for the border crossing.

What do I need to cross into Mexico?

U.S. citizens need a valid passport book to fly to Mexico, and a passport book or passport card for land crossings like San Diego–Tijuana. We’ll confirm the right document for your specific trip before you book — rules can change, so we verify at quote time.

Are prices really in USD?

Yes. Quotes for U.S. travelers are priced in USD with inclusions spelled out, so there are no conversion surprises. Your final price is confirmed in writing before you pay anything.

Is the quote free?

Yes — quotes are free and carry no obligation. We send options with itemized pricing and you decide whether to reserve.

Which tours can I book right now?

Only the four private Riviera Maya tours operated by Kay Tours Mexico — Chichén Itzá Classic, Sian Ka'an Express, Mayan Jungle Trek and Mayan Underworld — the only experiences on this page with published “from” prices, shown in the Tours section above. Your final price is confirmed in your quote based on your group size and travel date. Every other destination is quote-only until its local partner is fully confirmed, so nobody can buy a tour we can’t yet deliver.

How far ahead should I book?

For the Kay Tours private tours in Riviera Maya, 2–4 weeks ahead secures the best availability (popular dates go 1–2 months out). For quote-only destinations, the earlier you ask, the more options we can line up — but ask us about last-minute trips too.

What does my quote include?

Your quote spells out exactly what’s included before you pay anything: for the Kay Tours private tours, the confirmed per-person price for your group size and date plus the day’s details; for quote-only destinations, each piece — lodging, transfers, tours — itemized, with no fine-print surprises.

Who actually runs my tour?

A vetted local operator in that destination — the winery team, boat crew, certified guide or driver who runs that experience every day. In Riviera Maya, the four bookable private tours are operated by our local partner Kay Tours Mexico. Penavia is your agency: we sell and coordinate your reservation, purchase and confirm the tour with the operator, coordinate pickup and details, and handle support and any changes with them for you.

Who do I pay?

You pay Penavia, in USD, at the price confirmed in your quote — a 50% deposit holds your reservation. We then pay the operator — you don’t need to pay providers separately on the day, except for anything clearly listed as not included (for example tips or personal expenses).

What if I need to cancel?

Clear terms, no surprises. Cancel within 24 hours of booking and you get a full refund, as long as your tour is more than 7 days away. Cancel 30 or more days before your tour and you only lose the 10% booking fee already included in your deposit; between 8 and 30 days ahead, the charge is 50%; from 7 days to 72 hours ahead it is also 50%; inside 72 hours or for a no-show there is no refund. Your first date change is free up to 8 days before the tour, and name changes are free up to 24 hours before. If we or the operator ever cancel, you choose: a full refund or a new date, at no cost.

Do you only serve U.S. travelers?

The U.S. is our first international market because Baja is right next door — but we plan Mexico trips for travelers from anywhere. Canada, the UK and Australia are next on our roadmap.

Can I book Punta Cana, Costa Rica, Peru, Colombia or Jamaica yet?

Not quite yet — we’re onboarding local partners in those destinations right now, and we only open bookings once a partner has signed on with confirmed rates, so we never sell a trip we can’t deliver. You can already request a quote for any of them: it’s free, it tells us which destination has the most demand, and you’ll be first to get pricing when it launches.
